subject.title: fix(workboard): preserve proof history across later card writes

question: Should Workboard permanently expose the new opt-in `proofView: "bounded"` read mode and the two cursor-based proof-list operations as supported public interfaces alongside full-history defaults?
rationale: The data-loss repair is a concrete bug fix, but the bounded projection and pagination endpoints add durable Gateway and agent-tool surface beyond the minimum storage correction.

options.title: Accept the bounded public interface
options.body: Merge the lossless persistence repair together with the documented opt-in bounded views and cursor-based proof pagination.

options.title: Narrow the PR to persistence
options.body: Keep full proof retention and defer the new bounded view and proof-pagination API to a separately approved interface proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded public interface
recommendation.body: Merge the lossless persistence repair together with the documented opt-in bounded views and cursor-based proof pagination.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest established history is the prior merged Workboard proof-lifecycle design, including its proof-contract decisions.
